title: The War Of The Stray Dog
description:
In October 1925 Greece briefly invaded Bulgaria in the Incident at Petrich, sometimes called the War of the Stray Dog. In one version of events, it started on 18 October when a Greek soldier ran after his dog, which had strayed across the border, and was shot by a Bulgarian sentry; in the second, Greek claims say Bulgarian soldiers attacked a Greek outpost. Greece issued a 48-hour ultimatum demanding punishment, an apology and two million French francs, and on 22 October Greek troops occupied Petrich. The League of Nations ordered a cease-fire and withdrawal, and Greece paid 45,000 pounds in compensation.

Source: Wikipedia, 'Incident at Petrich'. There were about 50 victims, mostly civilians, on the Bulgarian side.
